hindi: व्यवहार वह है जिसमें विवाह पहले आता है।
english: The dealings (vyavahāra) are those having marriage first.
notes: Opening statement of the chapter. vyavahāra is the technical term for legal dealings; rendered 'dealings' per glossary. pūrva in the bahuvrīhi may also mean 'preceded by' (marriage coming before the other dealings); rendered literally.

hindi: कन्या को अलंकृत करके कन्या का दान करना ब्राह्म विवाह है।
english: The giving of a maiden, having adorned the maiden, is the Brāhma marriage.

hindi: साथ मिलकर धर्म का आचरण प्राजापत्य है।
english: Practising dharma together is the Prājāpatya [marriage].
notes: vivāhaḥ is not repeated in the Sanskrit; supplied in brackets in English only (also in units 4 to 9).

words.gloss: from the taking of a pair of cattle

hindi: गो के जोड़े के ग्रहण से आर्ष है।
english: From the taking of a pair of cattle [it is] the Ārṣa [marriage].
notes: go-mithuna rendered literally as 'pair of cattle' (commentators may specify a cow and a bull).

hindi: वेदी के भीतर ऋत्विज् को दान करने से दैव है।
english: From giving [the maiden] to an officiating priest within the altar [it is] the Daiva [marriage].
notes: The object of the giving (the maiden) is understood from unit 2. antar-vedyām: 'within the (sacrificial) altar'.

hindi: पारस्परिक मिलन से गान्धर्व है।
english: From mutual union [it is] the Gāndharva [marriage].

hindi: शुल्क के ग्रहण से आसुर है।
english: From the taking of bride-price [it is] the Āsura [marriage].
notes: śulka = bride-price in this chapter (as in 4.12); the word elsewhere means toll or duty.

hindi: बलपूर्वक ग्रहण से राक्षस है।
english: From taking by force [it is] the Rākṣasa [marriage].
notes: prasahya is an absolutive ('having overpowered') used as first member.

words.gloss: from the taking of one asleep or intoxicated

hindi: सोए हुए या मदमत्त के ग्रहण से पैशाच है।
english: From the taking of one asleep or intoxicated [it is] the Paiśāca [marriage].
notes: supta and matta are gender-neutral in the compound; the object is not stated.

words.gloss: having mother and father as authority

hindi: पहले चार, जिनमें पिता प्रमाण है, धर्म्य हैं; शेष वे हैं जिनमें माता और पिता प्रमाण हैं।
english: The first four, having the father as authority, are in accordance with dharma; the rest have mother and father as authority.
notes: pramāṇa rendered 'authority' (alternative: 'decisive voice'). 'The first four' presumably means the types named in units 2 to 5, which the text does not repeat here.

words.gloss: in the absence of one of the two

hindi: क्योंकि वे दोनों कन्या के शुल्क को लेने वाले हैं, अथवा दोनों में से एक के अभाव में दूसरा।
english: For those two take the bride-price of the daughter, or, in the absence of one of the two, the other.
notes: 'Those two' presumably the father and the mother of unit 10; the text does not name them here. The second half has no finite verb of its own; read with the first half.

hindi: स्त्री दूसरा शुल्क ले।
english: The woman should take the second bride-price.
notes: The referent of 'second bride-price' and of 'woman' (the bride herself, or the mother) is not stated; rendered literally.

hindi: सबके लिए प्रीतिपूर्वक आरोपण निषिद्ध नहीं है। यह विवाह-धर्म है।
english: For all, the placing (āropaṇam) through affection is not forbidden. Such is the dharma of marriage.
notes: Doubtful: āropaṇa (from ā-√ruh, causative: 'causing to mount, placing upon') is obscure here; what is placed on whom, and whether prīti is 'affection' or 'agreement', is not stated. Rendered literally; no later commentary imported. The printed '| 13 |' is the edition's own sūtra number, kept as tokens. 'iti vivāha-dharmaḥ' closes the section: glossed as a closing label ('Such is ...').

hindi: स्त्रीधन वृत्ति अथवा आबन्ध्य है।
english: Woman's property (strī-dhana) is maintenance (vṛtti) or ābandhya.
notes: ābandhya kept as printed (obscure; literally 'what is to be bound on'; the type of property is not stated). vṛtti 'maintenance' is the literal sense.

words.gloss: having two thousand at the most

hindi: वृत्ति अधिकतम दो हज़ार की निर्धारित की जानी चाहिए; आबन्ध्य में कोई नियम नहीं।
english: Maintenance (vṛtti) is to be fixed at two thousand at the most; for ābandhya there is no restriction.
notes: The unit of money is not stated and none is added. para- before a number is read as 'at the most' (alternative: 'more than'); doubtful.

words.gloss: in the maintenance of self, son and daughter-in-law
when no provision is made during a stay abroad
in the remedy of robbers, disease, famine, fear
of the two who have produced

hindi: उसका उपभोग करने में पत्नी के लिए अपने, पुत्र और पुत्रवधू के भरण-पोषण में तथा प्रवास में व्यवस्था न किए जाने पर कोई दोष नहीं; पति के लिए प्रतिरोधक, रोग, अकाल, भय के प्रतिकार में तथा धर्म-कार्य में; अथवा जिस दम्पति ने जोड़ा उत्पन्न किया हो, उसके लिए मिलकर।
english: There is no fault in the wife's enjoying that [property] in the maintenance of herself, [her] son and [her] daughter-in-law, and when no provision is made during a stay abroad; [likewise] of the husband, in the remedy of robbers, disease, famine and fear, and in a dharma-act; or jointly, of the couple who have produced a pair.
notes: Doubtful: the last phrase 'sambhūya vā dampatyor mithunaṃ prajātayoḥ' is obscure; mithunam taken as 'pair' (of offspring), object of prajātayoḥ; alternative: 'union'. 'That' refers to the woman's property of the previous units. pratirodhaka glossed 'robber' per glossary (it could also be an adjective 'obstructing'). Hindi adds no conjunction in the list of dangers, as the Sanskrit has none.

hindi: और अत्यन्त धर्म्य विवाहों में तीन वर्ष तक उपभोग किए हुए के विषय में पूछताछ न करे।
english: And in the marriages most in accordance with dharma, one should not question [what has been] enjoyed for three years.
notes: anuyuñjīta rendered 'question' per glossary (4.7); the sense 'call to account' is the likely intent. dharmiṣṭha is the superlative, presumably the first four types. The subject is not stated.

words.gloss: enjoyed in the Gāndharva and Āsura [marriages]
enjoyed in the Rākṣasa and Paiśāca [marriages]

hindi: गान्धर्व और आसुर विवाहों में उपभोग किए हुए के लिए दोनों वृद्धि सहित दिलाए जाएँ; राक्षस और पैशाच में उपभोग किए हुए को चोरी के रूप में दे।
english: As to what was enjoyed in the Gāndharva and Āsura [marriages], both [items] should be made to be given, with increase; what was enjoyed in the Rākṣasa and Paiśāca [marriages], [he] should give [it] as theft.
notes: 'Both' is not specified (presumably the bride-price and the woman's property of the earlier units). vṛddhi rendered 'increase' (commonly 'interest'). steyam: 'as theft'; alternative 'stolen property'. 'sa-' in sa-vṛddhikam is a prefix, so the printed hyphen join gets one word entry. The subject of both verbs is unstated.

hindi: पति के मरने पर धर्म की कामना वाली स्त्री उसी समय रखे जाने योग्य आभरण और शुल्क का शेष प्राप्त करे।
english: When the husband is dead, [a woman] desiring dharma should receive at that very time the ornaments to be set aside and the remainder of the bride-price.
notes: Doubtful: 'sthāpya-ābharaṇam' (printed with '-' join, so two entries): 'ornament to be set aside/kept in reserve'; the exact kind of ornament is not stated. Singular 'ornament' is used collectively.

words.gram: pres. part. mid. f. nom. sg. √vid

hindi: अथवा पाकर विवाह करने वाली स्त्री से दोनों वृद्धि सहित दिलवाए जाएँ।
english: Or, having received [them] and marrying, [she] should be made to give both, with increase.
notes: vindamānā (√vid, literally 'finding') is taken as 'marrying', the sense it carries in unit 39; no object is stated. 'Both' as in unit 18.

words.gloss: given by the father-in-law and the husband

hindi: परन्तु कुटुम्ब की कामना वाली स्त्री श्वशुर और पति द्वारा दिए हुए को बसने के समय प्राप्त करे।
english: But [a woman] desiring a family should receive what was given by the father-in-law and the husband at the time of niveśa (settling).
notes: niveśa literally 'settling, establishing (a household)'; taken here of her settling in marriage again; unit 22 promises an explanation. Hindi uses 'बसने' because निवेश means 'investment' in Hindi.

hindi: क्योंकि दीर्घ प्रवास में बसने के समय की हम व्याख्या करेंगे।
english: For we shall explain the time of niveśa (settling) in the case of a long stay abroad.
notes: The explanation is promised, not given, in this unit. 'hi' could also be emphatic ('indeed').

words.gloss: given by the father-in-law and the husband

hindi: अथवा श्वशुर के विपरीत बसी हुई स्त्री श्वशुर और पति द्वारा दिए हुए को खो दे।
english: Or [a woman] who has settled in opposition to the father-in-law should lose what was given by the father-in-law and the husband.
notes: jīyeta: passive of √ji ('be deprived of, lose'), with accusative; alternative derivation √jyā, same sense. niviṣṭā 'settled' as in unit 21.

words.gloss: of one laid hold of from the hand of relatives

hindi: जाति-बन्धुओं के हाथ से पकड़ी गई स्त्री के लिए ज्ञाति-जन जैसा लिया हो वैसा दें।
english: For [a woman] laid hold of from the hand of relatives, the relatives should give [it] as it was taken.
notes: Doubtful: abhimṛṣṭā (abhi-√mṛś, 'touched, laid hold of') is rendered literally; the situation (a woman taken from her relatives' hand, e.g. in marriage) and the thing given are not stated. The printed ablative inside the compound (hastād.) is unusual but kept. The final -yā is regular sandhi for -yāḥ before a voiced consonant.

words.gloss: of one who has come by rule

hindi: न्यायपूर्वक आई हुई स्त्री के स्त्रीधन की उसे ग्रहण करने वाला रक्षा करे।
english: Of [a woman] who has come in accordance with rule, the one who takes charge [of her] should guard the woman's property.
notes: Doubtful: pratipattṛ 'one who takes up / takes charge'; gopayet 'guard' (alternative 'conceal'). nyāya 'rule, proper way' is not further specified.

words.gram: pres. part. mid. f. nom. sg. √vid

hindi: पति के दाय को विवाह करती हुई वह खो दे।
english: [A woman] marrying should lose the husband's share (dāya).
notes: vindamānā 'marrying' as in unit 20; jīyeta takes the accusative pati-dāyam. dāya 'share, gift, inheritance'.

hindi: धर्म की कामना वाली स्त्री उपभोग करे।
english: [A woman] desiring dharma should enjoy [it].
notes: The object (the husband's share of unit 26) is understood; not stated in the Sanskrit.

words.gram: pres. part. mid. f. nom. sg. √vid

hindi: पुत्रवती स्त्री विवाह करती हुई स्त्रीधन खो दे।
english: [A woman] having a son, marrying, should lose the woman's property.
notes: putravatī may also mean 'having sons'.

hindi: परन्तु उस स्त्रीधन को पुत्र ले लें।
english: But the sons should take that woman's property.

words.gloss: for the purpose of supporting sons

words.gram: pres. part. mid. f. nom. sg. √vid

words.gloss: for the sake of the sons

hindi: अथवा पुत्रों के भरण-पोषण के लिए विवाह करती हुई वह पुत्रों के लिए उसे बढ़ाए।
english: Or, marrying for the purpose of supporting [her] sons, she should make [it] increase for the sons' sake.
notes: The object (the woman's property) is understood. sphātī-kṛ: 'make flourish, increase'.

hindi: अनेक पुरुषों से उत्पन्न पुत्रों के लिए पिता द्वारा जैसा दिया गया हो, उसके अनुसार स्त्रीधन की व्यवस्था करे।
english: For sons born of many men, [she] should settle the woman's property as given by the father.
notes: The subject (the mother) is not stated. 'As given by the father': presumably each father's gift is kept for his own sons; the Sanskrit says only 'the father' (singular).

words.gram: pres. part. mid. f. nom. sg. √vid

hindi: इच्छानुसार करने योग्य स्त्रीधन को भी विवाह करती हुई वह पुत्रों के पास स्थित करे।
english: Even [the part of] woman's property that is to be done as desired, [a woman] marrying should make [it] established with the sons.
notes: Doubtful: kāma-karaṇīya, literally 'to be done for/according to desire' (property she may use freely, or property meant for pleasure); putra-saṃstha, literally 'standing/placed with the sons'. Both rendered literally.

words.gram: pres. part. f. nom. sg. caus. √pā

hindi: पुत्रहीन स्त्री पति की शय्या का पालन करती हुई गुरुजन के समीप आयु के क्षय तक स्त्रीधन का उपभोग करे।
english: A sonless [woman], guarding her husband's bed, should enjoy the woman's property near the elder until the waning of life.
notes: The ablative āyuḥ-kṣayāt is read as limit ('until'). guru 'elder' (singular in the Sanskrit; Hindi plural-collective गुरुजन as in the glossary). 'Guarding the husband's bed' is rendered literally.

hindi: क्योंकि स्त्रीधन आपत्ति के प्रयोजन वाला है।
english: For woman's property has adversity as its purpose.

hindi: बाद में दायाद के पास जाए।
english: [It] should go afterwards to the heir.
notes: The subject (the woman's property) is understood from unit 34; 'afterwards' presumably after her lifetime (unit 33).

hindi: पति के जीवित रहते मरी हुई स्त्री के स्त्रीधन को पुत्र और पुत्रियाँ बाँट लें; पुत्रहीन के स्त्रीधन को पुत्रियाँ; उनके अभाव में पति।
english: While the husband is living, for one who has died, the sons and daughters should divide the woman's property; for a sonless [woman], the daughters; in their absence, the husband.
notes: Elliptical: the verb and object are carried over to the later clauses. 'tat' in tad-abhāve taken as the daughters just named; alternative: 'that (property)'.

hindi: शुल्क, अन्वाधेय अथवा बन्धुओं द्वारा दिया हुआ अन्य, बान्धव ले लें। यह स्त्रीधन का कल्प है।
english: The bride-price, the anvādheya, or another [gift] given by relatives: the kinsmen should take [it]. Such is the procedure (kalpa) concerning woman's property.
notes: Ambiguity: whether 'given by relatives' qualifies all three items or only 'other'. anvādheya kept as a term; literally 'what is added afterwards'. bandhu and bāndhava are both 'relatives/kinsmen'; rendered 'relatives' and 'kinsmen'. The printed '| 37 |' is the edition's own sūtra number. 'iti strī-dhana-kalpaḥ' closes the section (closing label).

words.gram: pres. part. f. acc. sg. a-pra-√jan

hindi: आठ वर्ष तक प्रसव न करने वाली, पुत्रहीन और बाँझ की प्रतीक्षा करे; दस वर्ष निन्दु की; बारह वर्ष कन्याओं को जन्म देने वाली की।
english: [He] should wait eight years for a [woman] not giving birth, sonless and barren; [ten years] for a nindu; [twelve years] for one bearing daughters.
notes: nindu is obscure and kept as printed (the dictionary sense is a woman whose children die; low confidence). 'ca' here joins the three descriptions, though the Sanskrit lists them without further 'ca'; the join '-' links ca and ākāṅkṣeta. The subject is not stated. 'Years' is carried over to 'ten' and 'twelve' (bracketed in English).

hindi: तब पुत्र की कामना करने वाला दूसरी से विवाह करे।
english: Then, desiring a son, [he] should marry a second [wife].
notes: vindeta: √vid 'find, obtain', here 'marry' as in unit 20. 'wife' is supplied by the feminine form. The subject is not stated.

hindi: उसके अतिक्रमण पर शुल्क, स्त्रीधन और आधा आधिवेदनिक दे, और अधिकतम चौबीस पण का दण्ड।
english: In the transgression of that, [he] should give the bride-price, the woman's property, and half [as] ādhivedanika, and a penalty of twenty-four paṇas at the most.
notes: Doubtful: 'half' (of what?) and ādhivedanika (kept as a term; it relates to adhivedana, the taking of a further wife) are not explained in the Sanskrit. para- after a number read as 'at the most', as in unit 15. 'tasya' refers to the rule of unit 39. daṇḍa = penalty (glossary 4.10).

words.gloss: of/to one without bride-price and woman's property
words.gram: f. gen. or dat. sg. bahuvrīhi

hindi: शुल्क-रहित और स्त्रीधन-रहित को शुल्क, स्त्रीधन, उसके माप का आधिवेदनिक और उपयुक्त वृत्ति देकर वह अनेक स्त्रियों से भी विवाह करे।
english: Having given the bride-price and the woman's property to one without bride-price and woman's property, an ādhivedanika of that measure, and suitable maintenance, [he] may marry even many [women].
notes: Doubtful: the compound aśulka-strī-dhanāyāḥ may be read 'to one who has neither bride-price nor woman's property' (taken here) or 'to one whose woman's property is without bride-price'; case may be genitive or dative. The subject is not stated.

hindi: क्योंकि स्त्रियाँ पुत्र के प्रयोजन वाली हैं।
english: For women have sons as their purpose.

hindi: और इनके तीर्थ एक साथ आने पर विवाह के अनुसार पहले विवाहित अथवा जीवित पुत्र वाली के पास पहले जाए।
english: And when the tīrtha of these [women] coincide, [he] should go first, according to marriage, to the one married earlier or to one having a living son.
notes: tīrtha is obscure here (literally 'ford, access'; commentators may take it as a fertile time) and is kept as printed. 'According to marriage' presumably means in the order of the marriages. The subject is not stated. Hindi तीर्थ here does not mean a place of pilgrimage.

words.gloss: in concealment of the tīrtha and approach

hindi: तीर्थ के गोपन और आगमन में दण्ड छियानवे है।
english: In concealing the tīrtha and in approach, the penalty is ninety-six.
notes: Doubtful: whether the compound is a dvandva ('concealment of the tīrtha, and approach') or one phrase ('approach with the tīrtha concealed'). The unit of the penalty is not stated and none is added.

hindi: अनिच्छुक पुत्रवती, धर्म की कामना वाली, बाँझ, निन्दु अथवा रज-रहित स्त्री के पास न जाए।
english: [He] should not approach an unwilling [woman] who has a son, desires dharma, is barren, is a nindu, or is without rajas.
notes: nindu as in unit 38. nīrajaska is literally 'without rajas' (rajas may mean menstrual flow or dust); kept literal. Printed 'na-akāmām' is read as na + akāmām; the negation applies to approaching such a woman against her will. The subject is not stated.

hindi: और अनिच्छुक पुरुष कुष्ठ से पीड़ित अथवा उन्मत्त स्त्री के पास न जाए।
english: And an unwilling man should not go to a [woman] afflicted with kuṣṭha (a skin affliction) or mad.
notes: kuṣṭha is a skin affliction in the plain literal sense; no modern diagnosis is given.

words.gloss: for the sake of a son

hindi: परन्तु स्त्री पुत्र के लिए या ऐसे प्रकार वाले के पास जाए।
english: But a woman should approach for the sake of a son, or [approach] one of such a kind.
notes: Doubtful: 'vā-upagacchet' (printed with a '-' join) is taken as vā + upagacchet; 'one of such a kind' presumably the men of unit 46 (afflicted or mad); 'or' may instead be read as 'even'. Rendered literally.

hindi: जो पति नीचता को या परदेश को चला गया हो, राजा का अपराधी हो, प्राणों पर आघात करने वाला हो, पतित हो, अथवा नपुंसक भी हो, वह त्याज्य है।
english: A husband who has gone forth to lowness or to another country, an offender against the king, one who strikes at life, fallen, or even impotent, is to be abandoned.
notes: nīcatva 'lowness, baseness' is rendered literally (its precise sense, e.g. degradation, is not stated); 'one who strikes at life' does not say whose life. Metre: anuṣṭubh, 16 syllables to each line; no scribal problem seen.
